needs.premise: One owned async task, publication ticket, queue/claim/native-issue/running/parked/future/completed states and two epochs; queued and running profiles; early native gate, complete adapters, atomic claim/cancel, participating parked root view and whole-round preparation are premises; no full collector, arbitrary recursion, C source/ABI/weak-memory or liveness proof

24 conditional declarations: gate closure does not drain existing work, deferred-task exclusions, epoch/context/root/binding authorization and custody Step/Trace, parked resume keeps invocation count; not every QNT action or C source simulation

No existing future-epoch execution-gate issuer; introduce VM-owned AdmissionDomain keyed by VM/domain/epoch/incarnation, with early native ingress covering every callback origin before data_rc, marker allocation, PSTATE reads or closure-self mutation; stop current publication admission, reconcile publication postludes and all claim reservations, then sign FutureEpochGate for retained unstarted async tasks only after canonical VM root/resource/code custody and manifest/exclusion evidence

Owned procedural interrupt queue needs one ordered dequeue-to-claim and close-to-detach cut under compatible exclusion; register claim before removing head/unlocking, count publisher from header initialization through queue insertion and post-unlock raise_interrupt_pstate; queued task may move to VM future queue with exact execution/release operation semantics, borrowed argument snapshot and custody; preserve accepted enqueue order and per-origin result causality, including canceled claim position unless reordering separately admitted; empty old queue or interrupt masking is not zero in-flight work

Already claimed/native-issued/running invocation is not an unstarted future task; unissued owned claim may cancel only under same atomic arbitration as native issue/start, lost claim response remains canonical duty; running invocation either completes or participates in GC with a qualified parked-current root/continuation/PSTATE view and revoked current write permit; parked native activation retains catcher/code/resource identity and resumes in place, never replayed as new callback

After full strong/weak/cleanup/capacity result and selected context preparation, bind exact live owner/VM context, reload relocated root handles, then publish next epoch authority; GC interrupt notification alone precedes prepare_mem_pstate and is not WholeRoundResumeSeal; claimFuture atomically joins next epoch before marker allocation and Scheme entry, parked resume obtains fresh write authority for same native activation; stale old epoch/context/root/owner rejects without guessed rebind

Future task and parked current invocation retain GC-visible roots, immutable input snapshots or qualified borrowed storage, native payload/code/catcher leases and exact result identity; VM transfer is not disposal, nonzero processor roots require all-domain scanner integration, native deletion/refcount decrement cannot reclaim before old invocation borrowers drain; unknown native or claim outcome retains custody and cannot authorize replay/refund

Defer only an origin whose request/result contract permits retained asynchronous task and whose pre-entry transport has no unknown issued invocation; direct synchronous Tcl scheme_call_cmd needs immediate char-string result and borrowed argv, so deferring inside it or returning invented success/pending is not equivalent; gate upstream initiation, qualify participating wait on original invocation, or refuse future-task admission; no synchronous GC wait for a callback whose entry waits for that same GC

Close/claim/cancel/native-issue publish under one canonical atomic/exclusion protocol; release certificate follows last current writer and publisher postlude, acquire certifier sees roots and parked views; next epoch release follows capacity/context/binding/root reload and acquire claimant joins matching epoch; all raw callbacks use compatible lifetime-protected ingress before first managed effect; counter generation alone cannot revoke issued stores or cached function pointers, actual C atomic layout and native ABI remain open

Saved catcher identity and native frame/thread incarnation are pinned before installing local guard; restoring the exact predecessor is a write under source borrow before dropping that guard; generated state used after jump lives in protected off-stack storage, not changed nonvolatile automatic locals; borrowed jmp_buf remains a live same-thread target and is never handed to GC/helper worker for longjmp; builtin/library/dynamic-import profiles require separate C/backend qualification

propagate_error NO_ERR returns but still reads native context, nonzero calls throw_error and THROW writes longjmp_err then jumps; reserve propagation receiver and root/code/PSTATE duty before original close/drop; matching ___call restores frame after local catcher restoration, nonmatching rethrows to outer target; trampoline-only trips keep original guard alive; ordinary CFUN conversion errors return/jump to handler before propagate_error, UNWIND_C_STACK can reach it; no arbitrary replay of throw

PSTATE pins cover catcher/longjmp_err, conversion temps, fp/R0 restore, W_ALL/R_ALL and CFUN_OOL caller status reads; local close cannot set total borrow count to zero while outer receiver/caller/nested activation remains; source cleanup permit needs all source pins zero plus observed VM acceptance and physical unlink/root-view evidence; activation identity is not processor or reused stack address

Conversion release helpers, AT_END text, release_foreign and procedural interrupt execute_fn are separate effect producers; register child cleanup duty before callback exposure or parent discharge; invoke only admitted origin/thread/effect profile, transfer root/native/code custody before dropping source pin, and keep child data debt after VM-independent transfer; deferral of unstarted child into a successor epoch additionally needs no current write authority or queued native invocation, closed admission and future reentry gate, preserving task/root/native debt; unknown acceptance or callback longjmp retains duty, cannot guess completion or refund

Replace managed generated END/cleanup exits and raw marker retirement with one off-stack exit service and exactly-once disposition, route shrink/rollback/shutdown/exported cleanup through permit; cleanup callback registration competes with final admission cut atomically; callback added after cut must refuse or enter a separately counted successor cohort before domain freeze, never reopen old seal; failed/unknown native join retains thread/TLS/code envelope independently of data closure

Original-to-receiver and parent-to-callback ticket publication precedes source release with one canonical authority; coordinator acquire sees all closures and zero outstanding effects; cleanup acquires accepted VM view and exact zero source-pin census under admission exclusion; native C emitter preserves standard setjmp call context, lifetime and local-value rules or qualified builtin profile, and atomic/lock implementation, layout and compiler code-motion remain unproved

gateCosts.removedWork: Replace assumed unstarted bit with ordered source-backed exclusion
gateCosts.bound: 0 existing full issuers; close producers + publication debt0 + exact claim census
gateCosts.addedCost: AdmissionDomain, origin registry and canonical certificate
gateCosts.condition: Unknown raw aliases or transport invocation refuse task qualification

gateCosts.bound: 1 publication ticket spans header, queue and PSTATE wakeup
gateCosts.addedCost: One ticket per active publisher and target/code lease
gateCosts.condition: Queue detach alone cannot retire source PSTATE or wakeup resources

gateCosts.removedWork: Avoid treating queue empty as callback quiescence
gateCosts.bound: Reserve claim before dequeue unlock; close and claim have one ordered winner
gateCosts.addedCost: Claim state and canonical outcome query
gateCosts.condition: Unknown claim response retains obligation; no replay from missing ACK

gateCosts.removedWork: Allow participating pause without demanding callback completion before its GC
gateCosts.bound: Started invocation remains parked-current; resume does not increment invocation count
gateCosts.addedCost: Frozen roots, revoked current write permit, native catcher/owner lease
gateCosts.condition: Unqualified active callback must drain or remain unresolved; never reclassify as unstarted future task

gateCosts.removedWork: Avoid deferred result changing Tcl command semantics
gateCosts.bound: 0 automatic async conversion of synchronous callback
gateCosts.addedCost: Origin/result/input ownership classification, upstream gate if possible
gateCosts.condition: Future-task path rejected unless async contract or equivalent same-call participating wait is proved

gateCosts.removedWork: Remove reliance on stale PSTATE/root/epoch permission
gateCosts.bound: Next claim after whole-round, context preparation, owner binding and root reload; old seal immutable
gateCosts.addedCost: Prepared context/root version, per-claim epoch membership and C entry ticket
gateCosts.condition: INTR_GC notification or reused processor id alone insufficient

gateCosts.removedWork: Retain original task backing across GC and source removal
gateCosts.bound: 1 physical task/result backing; queued and parked live objects retain roots/resources/code
gateCosts.addedCost: VM all-domain root view, stable handles, transitive payload and code leases
gateCosts.condition: Transfer is not refund; unknown deletion/readers keep custody and may retain memory

gateCosts.removedWork: Permit GC without executing an unstarted future task
gateCosts.bound: No coordinator wait for future task execution; same-call parked path retains return identity
gateCosts.addedCost: Admission gate and participating wait/resume handshake
gateCosts.condition: Callback cannot wait on GC while holding required queue/publication locks; gate premise still needs native proof

gateCosts.removedWork: Avoid duplicate invocation on lost claim/result response
gateCosts.bound: At most1 initial invocation per modeled task; parked resume adds0; query adds0
gateCosts.addedCost: Canonical task identity/claim record and protected lookup
gateCosts.condition: Native invocation issue/cancel arbitration required; no exactly-once external side-effect proof

gateCosts.removedWork: Transfer backing instead of copying task merely for epoch change
gateCosts.bound: Inherited marker +24*M(t); gate metadata O(P+C+T); Peak=max_t(H+P+N+Q)
gateCosts.addedCost: P publishers, C claim/parked leases, T future tasks, roots/code/native envelopes
gateCosts.condition: Deferred task memory remains charged; unbounded arrivals/unknown readers can make Q unbounded; no peak decrease proved

gateCosts.removedWork: Replace unsafe raw managed enqueue/dequeue/direct-entry and notification-as-permission paths
gateCosts.bound: 0 production paths retired today; owned qualified cohort only
gateCosts.addedCost: Scheme-generated ingress/exit profile plus modern C AdmissionDomain and all-domain roots
gateCosts.condition: Every origin, producer postlude, parked participant, next-epoch and native-order gap must close first

gateCosts.removedWork: Make asynchronous tasks, native activation and execution context compositional
gateCosts.bound: 0 Zig-only necessary-support reduction established; same native transport/root/GC semantics
gateCosts.addedCost: Typed C service and Scheme effect generator, separate context/participant/worker roles
gateCosts.condition: Net benefit conditional on removed waits/replays/duplication exceeding gate and retention costs; no measured speedup

nodes.labelText: Origin / effect / result manifest\nasync task or synchronous native call
Close publisher admission\nretain header + wakeup tickets
Close early native entry gate\nclaim before dequeue unlock
Claimed / issued / running\nnot an unstarted future task
Complete or parked-current\nfrozen roots + native return identity
Current data quiescence -> GC\nfuture execution not required
Whole-round result + context capacity\nowner binding + relocated root reload
Publish fresh next epoch authority\nold seal stays immutable
Atomic future claim / parked resume\nbefore marker allocation and Scheme
VM task/root/native/code custody\ntransfer is not disposal
Unknown raw call / sync result / owner\nretain debt; refuse unsafe admission
SysML -> ASCENT -> QNT / Lean\nsource and C memory gaps open

callers.actualChain: Publisher writes h.next before lock, links queue under mutex, unlocks then raises interrupt using target PSTATE and select-abort
callers.hazard: Closing only queue link leaves post-unlock PSTATE writes or native device wakeup outstanding
callers.replacement: Publication lease begins before header effect and ends after wakeup; close producer admission, preserve exact target incarnation

callers.actualChain: Service removes head and updates tail under mutex, unlocks before execute_fn(intr,true)
callers.hazard: Queue empty while callback claimed or executing; no current active-call registry in this route
callers.replacement: Publish claim under same exclusion as dequeue before unlocking; close gate wins or registered claim remains owed

callers.actualChain: Cleanup walks queue and invokes execute_fn(intr,false) while queue mutex held
callers.hazard: Calling Scheme or reentrant enqueue under lock can wait on this GC or same lock
callers.replacement: Detach admitted release duties under lock; execute later with explicit effect/owner profile, not guessed cancellation semantics

callers.actualChain: Init accepts arbitrary execute_fn; GSTATE exports init/raise interface
callers.hazard: Local queue code cannot prove external producer quiescence, borrowed payload stability or true/false operation equivalence
callers.replacement: Typed origin/effect/result manifest and unregister/drain or owned queue exclusion; refuse unregistered raw origins

callers.actualChain: Native closure writes global c_closure_self before generated converter; RC payload stores Scheme proc
callers.hazard: Gate solely inside ___call is after raw ingress effect/root read; cached function pointer survives logical generation change
callers.replacement: Stable typed native entry thunk and metadata/code lease before first relevant effect; qualify global/TLS closure identity redesign

callers.actualChain: Generated callback fetches PSTATE, allocates marker, converts parameters, calls Scheme and may retry handler
callers.hazard: Late gate after BEGIN_SFUN already touched owner context and roots
callers.replacement: Generate admission/epoch/owner ticket before PSTATE-dependent conversions and marker allocation; preserve result ABI

callers.actualChain: make_marker allocates vector before copying proc; source root TODO remains; kill clears then refcount decrements
callers.hazard: Future queue metadata alone does not protect movable input or keep native frame valid
callers.replacement: VM root handle before marker allocation, fresh root reload after GC, retained native activation for parked path

callers.actualChain: scheme_call_cmd calls tcltk_call synchronously and immediately installs returned char string into Tcl
callers.hazard: Returning pending/success while Scheme result not computed changes command semantics; argv strings borrowed from native call
callers.replacement: No blanket task deferral; upstream host initiation gate or participating same-call wait, with separate result/input ownership

callers.actualChain: Delete callback releases Scheme object and RC client_data; result release later invokes Gambit release_string
callers.hazard: Deletion or wrapper refcount alone is no proof every copied/native invocation pointer has drained
callers.replacement: Native library origin lifetime evidence plus wrapper active leases; result and client_data custody survive deletion until actual borrower drain

callers.actualChain: Strong/weak/cleanup barriers and P0 resize precede per-PSTATE continuation prep; P0 raises INTR_GC before prepare_mem_pstate
callers.hazard: GC notification is not proof all context/root/phase gates ready for external reentry
callers.replacement: Coordinator canonical whole-round result and participant preparation receipts before next epoch publish; no current gate issuer inferred

callers.actualChain: prepare_mem_pstate writes fp/hp and stack/heap limits, refreshes interrupt limits; heap fudge can acquire next msection
callers.hazard: A root-safe task still cannot use old allocators/context limits after GC
callers.replacement: Bind next context incarnation/capacity outcome and reload roots before claim authorizes any managed allocation

callers.actualChain: Per-PSTATE RC payloads; mark_rc occurs in P0 branch; continuation/register/saved roots scanned per processor
callers.hazard: Transferred nonzero roots or native-held closure cannot be inferred covered from current P0 scan
callers.replacement: All-domain VM root registry and frozen parked view, stable handles with post-copy reload; preserve independent RC and still ownership

callers.actualChain: thread_set_pstate sets binding/TLS and affinity; startup attaches owner before execution
callers.hazard: Processor integer/TLS pointer alone is not next-epoch permission or native activation identity
callers.replacement: Exact VM/context/native-thread incarnation binding and fresh permission; unknown/mismatched owner refuses entry

callers.actualChain: ___call and return handler preserve native marker/catcher return rights; wrong processor or repeat return rejected
callers.hazard: Parked same call cannot be replayed as a fresh task or jumped by worker thread
callers.replacement: Participating wait keeps catcher/continuation roots/native stack live; resume same invocation under new write lease

callers.actualChain: PSTATE cleanup destroys still/RC/OS resources; shrink joins later and ignores result; VM destroys shared scan facilities
callers.hazard: Future task or parked native borrower may outlive source; failed/unknown join does not authorize code/context free
callers.replacement: Canonical VM custody and source borrower closure before data cleanup; retain native envelope on unknown stop

callers.actualChain: Public native callback/marker/interrupt functions and real c-define callbacks expose entry capabilities
callers.hazard: Swapping pointer or emptying owned queue cannot revoke cached foreign pointer or already-issued machine invocation
callers.replacement: Complete loaded origin/entry manifest, early stable thunk and transport exclusion receipt; unknown alias keeps qualification open
